caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden figure of a woman positioned against a solid blue background. The figure appears to be part of a larger decorative structure, likely a ship’s figurehead. She is shown standing with her left foot slightly forward and her head tilted upward, looking to her right. Her right hand is holding onto her chest near the neckline of her dress, while her left hand holds onto a carved object resembling a twisted rope or cornucopia. The woman is dressed in a flowing gown with short sleeves, a cinched waist, and floral details on the bodice. The base of the figure features elaborate, curling acanthus leaf carvings, enhancing the ornamental quality. The entire figure, including the base, is rendered in shades of beige and off-white, contrasting with the smooth blue background. The composition is vertical, and the figure is centered in the frame.
title: Figurehead from "Empress"
